lines.text: Jesus says not one temple stone will be left on another, and the disciples ask when and what the sign will be.
Jesus warns that many will come in His name, and tells them not to be alarmed by wars and rebellions.
Nation will rise against nation, with great earthquakes, floods, and pestilences in various places, and great signs from heaven.
Before all this, the disciples will be seized and brought before kings, and they will be betrayed by their servants and friends.
When Jerusalem is surrounded by armies, those in Judea should flee to the mountains, and Jerusalem will be trodden down by the Gentiles.
